svg.title: Where the stations sit matters (simulated picks)
svg.desc: Two misfit maps of the same quake with simulated picks. Five stations all to the north give a long valley and a long uncertainty region; five stations around the quake give a small, round one.
svg.text: Where the stations sit matters (simulated picks)
The same quake located twice, each time with five stations. (a) the stand-ins for the five UHSN schools,
all north of the quake; (b) helper stations on several sides of it.
rough uncertainty: about 24 km by 5 km
rough uncertainty: about 7 km by 6 km
true epicenter (used to make the picks)
best fit from the simulated picks
station off the map: distance from the quake
Simulated: S − P from the true epicenter at 8 km depth (P 5.8 km/s, S 3.3 km/s), plus a random pick error
(about 0.1 s) at each station; located at the same depth. Station positions: University of Utah network (UU).
